deficits.suggestion: Add a pedestrian refuge island at the intersection to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing the wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the right side of the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during evening hours.

ratings.reason: The frames do not show the full width of the road or the specific location where a refuge island would be placed, making it impossible to confirm the deficit or the feasibility of the suggestion.
The pedestrian crossing area is not clearly visible in the frames, so the presence or absence of kerb ramps cannot be determined.
The images are taken during the day, so the presence or absence of street lighting cannot be assessed, and the feasibility of installation is unclear.
